user.title: Choose your street
user.description: Select the street of the address whose waste collection schedule you want to track.

data_description.street: Start typing to search. Streets are listed as published by PreZero Bielsko-Biała.
data_description.language: Language of entity names, calendar events and attributes. It can be changed later in the options; entity IDs are kept.

reconfigure.title: Change address
reconfigure.description: Select the new street. Entities, options and history are kept.

data_description.street: Start typing to search. Streets are listed as published by PreZero Bielsko-Biała.

data_description.number: Numbers are listed as published by PreZero Bielsko-Biała.

customer.title: Choose schedule
customer.description: There are multiple schedules for **{address}**, for example for separate buildings or businesses. Choose the one printed on your schedule or try one and change it later.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the PreZero Bielsko-Biała website. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_response: The PreZero Bielsko-Biała website returned an unexpected response. Try again later.
error.invalid_street: Street not found. Choose a street from the list.
error.invalid_number: House number not found. Choose a number from the list.
error.no_numbers: No house numbers are published for this street.
error.no_customer: No schedule is assigned to this address.
error.no_schedule: There is no schedule for this address in the current year yet.

data_description.language: Language of entity names, calendar events and attributes. It can be changed later in the options; entity IDs are kept.

refresh.name: Refreshing
refresh.description: How often the schedule is downloaded. Days until collection are recalculated every midnight without downloading.

data_description.refresh_interval: Failed downloads are retried after 30 minutes, then less often (up to every 6 hours).

reminders.name: Reminders
reminders.description: Reminder binary sensors turn on before a collection and can be used as automation triggers. Set 0 days to turn a reminder on at midnight of the collection day.

data_description.reminder_start: Time of day the reminder turns on, the configured number of days before the collection.
data_description.reminder_end: Time of day on the collection day the reminder turns off.

appearance.name: Appearance
appearance.description: Colored pictures are shown instead of icons in most dashboard cards. The colors are also available in the `color` attribute.

update_failed.message: Cannot download the waste collection schedule: {error}

entry_not_found.message: The selected config entry was not found.

entry_not_loaded.message: The selected config entry is not loaded.

fetch_failed.title: Cannot download the waste collection schedule for {address}
fetch_failed.description:
Downloading the schedule from the PreZero Bielsko-Biała website has been failing for over a day. The last known schedule is still used, so entities keep working, but changes published since then are missing.

Last error: `{error}`

Check the internet connection of Home Assistant and whether [the schedule website]({url}) works. This issue disappears after the next successful download.

schedule_missing.title: No waste collection schedule for {address} this year
schedule_missing.description: PreZero Bielsko-Biała has not published a schedule for {address} for the current year yet. This usually happens at the beginning of a year. The integration keeps checking and this issue disappears when the schedule is published.

address_not_found.title: Address {address} was not found
address_not_found.description: The PreZero Bielsko-Biała website no longer lists a schedule for {address}. The street may have been renamed or the address assigned a different schedule. Reconfigure the integration entry (**Settings > Devices & services > PreZero Bielsko-Biała > ⋮ > Reconfigure**) and select the address again.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Returns upcoming waste collections of a configured address.

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of days ahead to return.
